messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Religion and values in Algeria, Ghana, Indonesia, Jordan, Kenya, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, Mongolia, Malawi, Malaysia, Nigeria, Nepal, Singapore, and Viet Nam during the 2010s, matching this research need: Cross-national survey data on religiosity, religious beliefs and practices, attitudes toward gender equality, sexuality, abortion, science, church-state relations, social distance across religions, trust, wellbeing, and political-demographic characteristics.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
